mapper.select:
select bed.* from SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room inner join SMT_DORMITORY_BED bed on room.id=BED.ROOM_ID where ROOM_SEX=#{sex} and ROOM_TYPE=#{roomType} and bed.id not in (select BED_ID from SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF)
and bed.park_id=#{parkId}
and mod(bed.BED_NUMBER,2) = 0
and mod(bed.BED_NUMBER,2) = 1

select bed.PARK_ID,bed.dormitory_id, bed.FLOOR_ID,bed.ROOM_ID, bed.id bed_id, park_name,room_name,DORMITORY_name,floor_name ,bed.bed_number , types.id dormitory_type_id ,types.type_name dormitory_type_name from SMT_DORMITORY_BED bed inner join SMT_PARK park on bed.PARK_ID =PARK."ID" inner join SMT_DORMITORY dormitory on dormitory.id=bed.dormitory_id inner join SMT_DORMITORY_FLOOR floors on floors.id=bed.floor_id inner join SMT_DORMITORY_ROOM room on room.id=bed.room_id inner join SMT_DORMITORY_TYPE types on room.room_type=types.id where bed.id=#{id}
select * from SMT_OUT_DORMITORY_STAFF where STAFF_BADGE=#{staffBadge} and ALLOWANCE_TYPE=#{allowanceType} order by create_time desc

select id, process_id as processId, create_time as createTime from SMT_CALLOWANCE_CANCEL_RECORD where badge=#{staffBadge}
order by create_time desc

select ROOM_ID as id,count(*) as useBedNum from SMT_DORMITORY_STAFF
and ROOM_ID in
#{item}
GROUP BY ROOM_ID
